verses.arabicText: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.englishText: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.englishText: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.englishText: And the ships sailing with ease

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.englishText: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.englishText: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.englishText: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.englishText: By the heaven containing pathways,[1535]
verses.footnotes: [1535] Explained as tracks, layers or orbits.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, you are in differing speech.[1536]
verses.footnotes: [1536] About Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) and the Qur’ān.

verses.arabicText: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.englishText: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

verses.arabicText: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.englishText: Destroyed are the misinformers[1537]

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.englishText: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

verses.arabicText: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.englishText: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.englishText: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.arabicText: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.englishText: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

verses.arabicText: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.englishText: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

verses.arabicText: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.englishText: They used to sleep but little of the night,[1538]
verses.footnotes: [1538] i.e., spending a portion of the night in prayer and supplication.

verses.arabicText: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.englishText: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.englishText: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.englishText: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.englishText: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.englishText: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.englishText: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.englishText: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?[1539] -
verses.footnotes: [1539] Who were angels given honored positions by Allāh.

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.englishText: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

verses.arabicText: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.englishText: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

verses.arabicText: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.englishText: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.englishText: And he felt from them apprehension.[1540] They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

verses.arabicText: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.englishText: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.englishText: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.englishText: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.englishText: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals[1541]
verses.footnotes: [1541] i.e., those who defied Lot (upon him be peace).

verses.arabicText: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.englishText: To send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.englishText: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

verses.arabicText: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.englishText: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

verses.arabicText: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.englishText: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.[1542]
verses.footnotes: [1542] i.e., Lot and his family, excepting his wife.

verses.arabicText: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.englishText: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.englishText: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.[1543]

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.englishText: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.englishText: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.englishText: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.[1544]
verses.footnotes: [1544] Barren of any benefit, i.e., evil.

verses.arabicText: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.englishText: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.englishText: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

verses.arabicText: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.englishText: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

verses.arabicText: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.englishText: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

verses.arabicText: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.englishText: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.englishText: And the heaven We constructed with strength,[1545] and indeed, We are [its] expander.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.englishText: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

verses.arabicText: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.englishText: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

verses.arabicText: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.englishText: So flee to Allāh.[1546] Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.footnotes: [1546] i.e., turn to Allāh and take refuge in Him from disbelief and sin, thereby escaping His punishment.

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.englishText: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.englishText: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.arabicText: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.englishText: Did they suggest it to them?[1547] Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.footnotes: [1547] i.e., Did the former disbelievers pass on these words to the Makkans so that they repeat the same expressions?

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.englishText: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

verses.arabicText: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.englishText: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.englishText: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.arabicText: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.englishText: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.englishText: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,[1548] the firm possessor of strength.
verses.footnotes: [1548] Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence. His provision includes guidance.

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.englishText: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

verses.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.englishText: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
